'''Cards''' are the primary method by which players interact with [[Enemies|enemy ships]] in Cobalt Core. Cards require energy to play, and generally have positive effects including damage, movement, and buffs. 

The cards available during a run vary based on who is in your [[Characters|crew]], although some cards can only be obtained via visiting certain [[Events|events]], selecting specific boot options, playing certain cards, or piloting specific ships.

Cards are generally divided into one of three rarities: Common, Uncommon, and Rare. Rare cards are more likely to show up as rewards for defeating [[Bosses|Boss]] enemies.
